extraction.name: CONTEXTUAL
extraction.description: A dataset for evaluating context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning in large multimodal models, featuring human-crafted instructions that require joint reasoning over text and visual elements in images across eight visual scenarios.
extraction.creator: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng
extraction.citeAs: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng. CONTEXTUAL: Evaluating Context-Sensitive Text-Rich Visual Reasoning in Large Multimodal Models. Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning, Vienna, Austria. PMLR 235, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset consists of 506 samples with human-written instructions and responses. Images were sourced from six sources: LAION-5B (for Time, Shopping, Navigation, Abstract), Rico Dataset (Application Usage), scraped website screenshots (Web Usage), and reannotated images from InfographicVQA and STVQA/ESTVQA (Infographic, Miscellaneous Natural Scenes). Annotation involved manual filtering, heuristic-based filtering using PaddleOCR, and verification by MTurk workers and authors.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Web Scraping, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images from LAION-5B, Rico Dataset, Open WebText Initiative screenshots, and reannotated images from InfographicVQA, STVQA, and ESTVQA datasets.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Images underwent manual filtering for some categories and heuristic-based filtering using PaddleOCR to select top images with highest number of words for annotation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering of images based on OCR word count and manual suitability checks; verification process to filter out incorrect or low-quality samples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Authors divided into two groups annotated instructions and responses following guidelines to ensure context-sensitive reasoning. Verification involved MTurk workers and cross-group review.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Amazon Mechanical Turk (for verification and human baseline), manual annotation by authors.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Verification found 96% of samples were annotated correctly; incorrect samples were filtered out. Human evaluation used majority vote among three annotators for response acceptance.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: Each sample has one human-written instruction and response; human evaluation used three annotators per response.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Human annotators for baseline and evaluation were sourced from Amazon Mechanical Turk, mainly from the US; authors are researchers at University of California Los Angeles.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: PaddleOCR for text detection, ShareGPT-4V-7B for image captions, GPT-4 and GPT-4V for automatic evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Dataset, code, and leaderboard available on project page and Hugging Face; validation set of 100 samples released with reference responses, remaining 406 hidden for benchmarking.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Discusses potential for harmful responses from models and limitations in linguistic diversity of human annotators; aims to avoid offensive content and highlights need for diverse evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Human annotators mainly from the US, which may affect linguistic diversity and writing style in responses and evaluations.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dataset size (506 samples) may limit generalization; human annotations may not represent diverse social groups; models struggle with time reading and infographics.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning for evaluating context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning in large multimodal models; not recommended for tasks requiring only OCR or basic object understanding.
